purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the bronze NYC flights departure and arrival records, casting HHMM-encoded time fields and numeric measures to proper integer types, casting time_hour to a TIMESTAMP, and dropping Airbyte capture metadata, to feed downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, sched_arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable and explicitly decide how to handle nulls (these largely represent cancelled or unrecorded flights); join or group on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) to get one row per scheduled flight, and remember dep_time/sched_dep_time/arr_time/sched_arr_time remain HHMM integers rather than true time-of-day values.
limitations: dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, and air_time retain null rates between 2.94% and 3.30% (4883 to 5480 of 166158 rows) representing flights with no recorded departure or arrival, and tailnum is null for 0.92% of rows (1521); none of these were imputed. Time-of-day fields were not converted to a TIME or TIMESTAMP type because HHMM values up to 2400.0 are not valid clock representations, and duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 means no dedupe logic was exercised or tested against real duplicates.
